mapped.scope: dNBR+ polygons across assessed events first seen in 2026. A product output, with no confidence interval. Events the product could not assess are excluded, not counted as zero.

validated.events: The Task 18 dNBR+ product measured against hand labels on 1 m imagery, over the footprints of E0301, E0313, E0368.
validated.scope: Stratified estimate from the interpreted 1 m labels, covering the three labelled footprints only. Its mapped term is a subset of the mapped figure beside it, so the two are not alternative answers to one question.
